AgentArtifactId.description: Artifact identifiers are limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes by the contract; JSON Schema maxLength is intentionally omitted because it counts Unicode characters.

AgentBuildHostRisk.description: Agent-host responsibilities that an acknowledgement cannot replace.

AgentCondition.description: Rendered edge conditions are limited to 65536 UTF-8 bytes so a maximally sized condition remains routable within the fixed 1 MiB MCP page budget; maxLength is a conservative character cap while x-depgraph-maxUtf8Bytes carries the exact byte contract.

AgentDaemonControlOutcome.description:
Closed, path-free terminal decision for a durable daemon control operation.
Full lifecycle status remains available only through `daemon_get`.

AgentDaemonInvalidationSummary.description: Bounded, path-free evidence that an incremental attempt used a planned invalidation.

AgentGraphExportContent.description: Inline graph export content is limited to 16777216 UTF-8 bytes by the contract; JSON Schema maxLength is intentionally omitted because it counts Unicode characters.

AgentHealthHotspotScores.description: Closed MCP projection of all five hotspot score layers.

AgentNodeSummary.description: Closed four-field projection used only by bounded node discovery.

AgentOperation.description:
Portable, agent-safe state of a durable operation. Journal input, digests,
capability sets, leases, and runner handoff data are intentionally absent.

AgentPolicyText.description: Policy text is limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes by the contract; JSON Schema maxLength is intentionally omitted because it counts Unicode characters.

description: Closed common request, response, pagination, Agent DTO, and durable operation contracts. Consumers select the applicable schema from $defs.
